yunbeiuc.gui.sidebar.title: Patterns & Fonts
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.custom_patterns.de: Loaded from JSON files inside resource packs. See the mod documentation for a guide on creating custom patterns.
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.custom_fonts.desc: Loaded from JSON files inside resource packs. See the mod documentation for a guide on creating custom fonts.
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.builtin_fonts.desc: Fonts provided by vanilla Minecraft. Reference them with the "font" field of the -json directive.
yunbeiuc.gui.sections.font_rendering_war: Text layout in this mod relies heavily on the Minecraft font engine. If you have installed mods such as Caxton or Modern UI that deeply modify low-level text rendering, enabling, disabling or removing them mid-game will change character spacing, line height and glyph size, which can break the layout of existing signs. There is currently no universal fix; it is strongly recommended to keep a fixed font rendering environment for a given world or server.
yunbeiuc.gui.insert.title: Built-in Directives
yunbeiuc.gui.insert.rect.desc: : Draws a rectangle of the given size (affected by font size and scale).
yunbeiuc.gui.insert.texture.desc: : Displays a texture; the path must end with .png and the resource must exist.
yunbeiuc.gui.homepage.title: YunbeiUC · Patterns & Fonts
yunbeiuc.gui.homepage.welcome: Welcome to the Yunbei Urban Construction pattern & font picker
yunbeiuc.gui.homepage.intro.p1: Yunbei Urban Construction is a city building mod focused on reproducing urban traffic infrastructure, including road blocks, road signs, municipal facilities, traffic devices and utility items. It ships with a full text editing system and a customizable sign system, letting you freely lay out text, icons and patterns on signs.
yunbeiuc.gui.homepage.intro.p2: This screen is the built-in pattern & font picker. It inserts images and fonts into text lines: patterns are written as -texture directives, fonts as -json directives that can be combined with colors, bold and other styles.
yunbeiuc.gui.homepage.intro.p3: Besides the built-in patterns, this screen also reads player resource packs: drop correctly formatted JSON files and images into a resource pack and they will appear under "Custom Resource Packs". See the mod documentation for a guide.
